name: EVD
recent: EVD 近期将财政年度结束日改为9月30日，并发布了截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩。公司因可赎回优先股转换为普通股而多次发行新股，同时有一名董事离任，并涉及清盘呈请及重大诉讼事项。
notable: 财政年度结束日由其他日期改为9月30日。
可赎回优先股转换为普通股，分别发行723,225股及4,000,000股新股。
董事 Norhizam bin Abdul Kadir 离任。
risks: 公司涉及清盘呈请 / 接管 / 限制令相关公告。
优先股持续转换为新股，可能摊薄现有股东权益。

events.what_en: Listing of 723,225 new shares from pref share conversion

recent_en: EVD recently changed its financial year end to 30 September and announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026. The company issued new shares multiple times due to conversion of redeemable preference shares, saw a director step down, and is involved in winding-up petitions and material litigation.
notable_en: Changed financial year end to 30 September.
Conversion of redeemable preference shares into ordinary shares, issuing 723,225 and 4,000,000 new shares respectively.
Director Norhizam bin Abdul Kadir stepped down.
risks_en: The company made announcements related to winding-up / receiver & manager / restraining order.
The company is involved in material litigation.
Ongoing conversion of preference shares into new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
